Description

This dynamic animated clip simulates a cyber attack, displaying multiple red terminal windows filled with scrolling code and binary data. The screen is overlaid with a stark black background featuring subtle red binary numbers. As the animation progresses, a bold red message, 'SYSTEM HACKED!', appears with intense glitch and digital distortion effects, emphasizing a state of digital intrusion or system compromise. This visual effect is perfect for projects requiring a sense of urgency, danger, or technological disruption, ideal for sci-fi thrillers, cybersecurity presentations, or dramatic digital content. It conveys a modern, edgy feel with its stark color palette and raw, distressed digital aesthetic.
